cards.name: HOA President
cards.text: Stonewall: Once each of your turns, the first time you commit a Character to defend an opponent's Scenario, that Character gets +1 Health until the end of your next turn.

cards.name: Florida Man
cards.text: Reckless: Once each of your turns, after one of your Characters defeats an opposing Character at a Scenario, you may move one other Character you control from Home to that Scenario, respecting the three-Character limit.

cards.name: Old Guy
cards.text: Absorb 1 while defending an opposing Scenario.

cards.name: Helicopter Parent
cards.text: When committed to defend, give another friendly Character at that Scenario +1 Health until end of turn.

cards.name: Marine
cards.text: Retaliate.

cards.name: Grandma
cards.text: At start of your turn, heal 1 damage from a friendly Character at her Scenario.

cards.name: Neighborhood Watch
cards.text: When entering, you may commit it to an opposing Scenario.

cards.name: Board Member
cards.text: While supporting your Scenario, opponents cannot move your other supporting Characters with Actions.

cards.name: Violation Notice
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to an opposing Character at a Scenario where you have a Character.

cards.name: Objection!
cards.text: Return a friendly Character at a Scenario to your hand; draw 1 Main card.

cards.name: Photographic Evidence
cards.text: Attach to a friendly Character. That Character gets +1 Power while supporting a Scenario.

cards.name: Clipboard
cards.text: Attach to a friendly Character. That Character gets +1 Health.

cards.name: Emergency Meeting
cards.text: Ready up to two friendly Characters at the same Scenario; they cannot attack again this turn.

cards.name: Neighborhood Petition
cards.text: Search your Scenario Deck for a Scenario, reveal it, put it in hand, then shuffle that deck. (If none, shuffle only.)

cards.name: Boogie Boarder
cards.text: When defeated at a Scenario, draw 1 Main card.

cards.name: Spring Break Frat Bro
cards.text: Hothead.

cards.name: Amateur Storm Chaser
cards.text: When committed to your Scenario, gets +1 Power this turn.

cards.name: Hurricane Holdout
cards.text: Gets +1 Power for each damage counter on it.

cards.name: Lifeguard
cards.text: Absorb 1.

cards.name: Beach Bar Loudmouth
cards.text: When defeated at a Scenario, deal 2 damage to an opposing Character there.

cards.name: Hold My Beer
cards.text: A friendly Character at a Scenario gets +2 Power this turn and takes 1 damage.

cards.name: Walk It Off
cards.text: Heal 2 damage from a friendly Character; draw 1 Main card.

cards.name: Bolt Cutters
cards.text: Dismiss an Item attached to a Character at a Scenario where you have a Character.

cards.name: Truck Nuts
cards.text: Attach to a friendly Character. It gets +1 Power.

cards.name: Did You See That?!
cards.text: After you have defeated an opposing Character at a Scenario this turn, draw 2 Main cards.

cards.name: Watch This!
cards.text: A friendly Character at a Scenario gets Hothead and +2 Power this turn; it takes 2 damage after its next attack this turn.

cards.name: Your Christmas Lights Are Still Up in March!
cards.text: Opponent must have at least two contesting Characters here to prevent your default success check; with only one, you still succeed if you have a supporter. Default failure still applies.

cards.name: Your Grass Is 0.3 Inches Too Tall!
cards.text: Supporting Characters get -1 Power (minimum 0). When this succeeds, draw 1 Main card.

cards.name: Unauthorized Lawn Flamingo!
cards.text: Your supporting Characters here get +1 Health. When this succeeds, opponent dismisses an Item they control, if able.

cards.name: That's Not Up to Code!
cards.text: Attached Items on your supporting Characters here cannot be dismissed by opposing Actions. Instead of the default success check, succeed at the start of your turn if you have a supporting Character with an attached Item and no contesting Characters. Otherwise remain active unless default failure applies.

cards.name: You Parked on the Wrong Side of the Street!
cards.text: When an opponent commits a Character here, that Character rotates. Default success and failure apply.

cards.name: There's a Gator in My Pool!
cards.text: Whenever a Character is defeated here, its controller may immediately commit one of their Home Characters here, respecting capacity. When this succeeds, draw 1 Main card.

cards.name: That's Definitely Not Street Legal!
cards.text: Characters here with Power 4 or more get -1 Health. When this succeeds, ready one of your Stash cards.

cards.name: Hold My Beer, This Is a Shortcut!
cards.text: Your supporting Characters here get +1 Power and -1 Health. Default success and failure apply.

cards.name: The Neighbors Called the Cops Again!
cards.text: Opposing Characters committed here enter Rotated. When this succeeds, return an opposing Character from another Scenario to its owner's Home (not hand), if possible.

cards.name: I Can Explain the Fireworks!
cards.text: At the start of your turn, instead of the default success check, succeed if you have at least two supporting Characters here and no contesting Characters. Otherwise remain active unless default failure applies. When this succeeds, deal 2 damage to an opposing Character at another Scenario, if any.
